name: mfe-runner
description: Desktop control center for local applications, projects, libraries, processes, and logs

scripts.test: npm run test:electron && npm run test:angular
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: npm run clean:artifacts && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --dir
scripts.dist:mac:x64: npm run clean:artifacts && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --x64 --dir
scripts.dist:mac:arm64:installer: npm run clean:artifacts && npm run build && APPLE_KEYCHAIN_PROFILE=mfe-runner-notary electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:x64:installer: npm run clean:artifacts && npm run build && APPLE_KEYCHAIN_PROFILE=mfe-runner-notary electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win:arm64: npm run clean:artifacts && npm run build && electron-builder --win zip --arm64
scripts.dist:win:arm64:installer: npm run clean:artifacts && npm run build && ELECTRON_BUILDER_7Z_FILTER=BCJ electron-builder --win nsis --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win:arm64:portable: npm run clean:artifacts && npm run build && electron-builder --win portable --arm64
scripts.dist:win:arm64:unpacked: npm run clean:artifacts && npm run build && electron-builder --win --arm64 --dir
scripts.dist:win:ia32: npm run clean:artifacts && npm run build && electron-builder --win zip --ia32 --publish never
scripts.dist:win:ia32:installer: npm run clean:artifacts && npm run build && ELECTRON_BUILDER_7Z_FILTER=BCJ electron-builder --win nsis --ia32 --publish never
scripts.dist:win:ia32:unpacked: npm run clean:artifacts && npm run build && electron-builder --win --ia32 --dir
scripts.dist:linux:arm64: npm run clean:artifacts && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --arm64 --dir
scripts.dist:linux:arm64:installer: npm run clean:artifacts && npm run build && electron-builder --linux deb --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux:x64: npm run clean:artifacts && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --x64 --dir
scripts.dist:linux:x64:installer: npm run clean:artifacts && npm run build && electron-builder --linux deb --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:installers: npm run clean:artifacts && npm run build && APPLE_KEYCHAIN_PROFILE=mfe-runner-notary electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --x64 --publish never && ELECTRON_BUILDER_7Z_FILTER=BCJ electron-builder --win nsis --arm64 --ia32 --publish never && electron-builder --linux deb --arm64 --x64 --publish never
